system.description:
Portions of the Antediluvian within you are not only present, they're active, acting like a cancer that devours you from the inside out. Your very blood is wrought with a corrosive, flesh-eating taint. At the beginning of each evening you suffer one health level of bashing damage that cannot be soaked or healed with blood. The only way to counteract the effect is by ingesting one-tenth of your body weight in flesh to supplement your depleted carcass, whether killing and devouring the flesh of victims or raiding a biohazard container from a liposuction clinic. If you try to ingest this macabre meal before the damage is done, you simply vomit it back up like any other food — this does not impart the benefits of the Eat Food Merit.

MET System: When testing for blood at the beginning of each game session, you suffer a level of bashing damage that can only be healed by ingesting mortal flesh sufficient to replace what this Flaw has consumed. You cannot pre-empt the effect by eating flesh beforehand; without the Eat Food Merit, you vomit it out like any other food.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
